items.title: Gold price drops to session lows as U.S. CPI heats up in September
items.summary: US annual inflation rose to 3.7% in September, above the 3.6% expected, strengthening bets on a Fed rate hike; the odds of an October hike climbed to 47% from 21%. Spot gold fell more than 1% to $4,107.30 as the dollar and yields rose.

items.title: Giá nhà đất giảm 15% trong 9 tháng, lãi suất 14-16% có thể kéo tỷ lệ hấp thụ xuống dưới 20%
items.summary: Theo DXS-FERI, giá rao bán nhà đất trung bình toàn quốc giảm từ khoảng 101 triệu đồng/m² cuối 2025 xuống khoảng 86 triệu đồng/m² trong quý 3. Tỷ lệ hấp thụ có thể đạt 40-45% nếu lãi suất thả nổi dưới 12%, nhưng có thể xuống dưới 20% nếu lãi suất lên 14-16%.

items.title: Parent engagement activates toddlers' brains differently than screen time
items.summary: A Northwestern University study in Brain and Language recorded EEG from 49 toddlers aged 24 to 44 months. During play and reading with a parent, the children showed lower alpha and higher theta brain activity than while watching a movie.

items.title: Redesigning source control at Anthropic
items.summary: Anthropic's merges rose from about 2,500 a day in May 2026 to over 30,000 a day by September. A seven-person team built its own source control system, Scion, and migrated off Git in five months.

items.title: Google Antigravity SDK adds local model support
items.summary: Google's Antigravity SDK can now run agentic workflows on local models, keeping planning in the cloud while local agents do code-heavy work. It supports Gemma 4 through LiteRT and OpenAI-compatible local servers such as Ollama, LM Studio and vLLM.
